guides.title: Study 2 Chronicles
guides.description: Follow selected chapters through the book.

steps.title: Solomon seeks wisdom
steps.text: Solomon seeks wisdom at Gibeon. The chapter also describes royal wealth, horses, and trade. Solomon asks for wisdom to lead the people. God grants wisdom and also gives him wealth.

steps.title: Correction and impartial judgment
steps.text: Jehu rebukes Jehoshaphat’s alliance. The king appoints judges and distinguishes religious and royal responsibilities. Jehoshaphat appoints judges and warns them against bribes. Their decisions must serve justice.

steps.title: Exile and Cyrus’s proclamation
steps.text: The final kings face Egypt and Babylon. Jerusalem and the temple fall. Cyrus allows a return to rebuild the temple. Jerusalem falls, and people go into exile. Cyrus later permits a return to rebuild the temple.
